m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: So the Hunters did create the Sphinx? I knew they would. And it told riddles? That's darned peculiar.
But then the Hunters Guild always were more brawn than brain, so maybe their own insecurity about their intelligence tinted the myth a bit.
It's a strange world, Wizard, but we've made it our own and I wouldn't have it any other way.
Are you going after the Sphinx? We done tried that, my fellow hunters and I. It went badly.
That Sphinx is a monster... a demon... it attacked us with... RIDDLES! It speaks in your mind with hideous brainteasers, thought-melters.
The headaches, I thought they'd never end. Not from the telepathy, but from those riddles. They're almost more than a mortal mind can bear.
Don't venture into that cavern, Wizard, for your own sanity. Forget my fellow hunters, they're all but lost.
Don't go into that tunnel. Don't go after the Sphinx. It's just too confusing.
